name: Echo Leaf
body:
Price 300 gp; Aura faint illusion; CL 3; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This leaf is imbued with the magic of silence, but instead of imposing silence, whomever consumes an echo leaf as a standard action is immune to the effects of silence for 1 minute.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 150 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Spells silence
